summary.intent: Win the Lio 'Keep the Line Running' hackathon challenge for Soony: analyze the confidential supplier data drops, find launch risks the plan hides, and build a general agent product that rechecks and acts (supplier emails, alerts, voice/phone) with a decision inbox.
summary.outcome: Found the key launch risks (overbooked art books, failed statue lot, game card shortfall, sleeve revision conflict, magnet false alarm). Built a polling watcher, a voice/push/PWA alert agent, supplier reply matching and a unified one-server setup. Then ported the alert agent onto Akshat's new card API and UI on a branch from akshat/integration; the final commit and a new PR into that branch were still pending.

repo: Portal API has only three endpoints (files list, single file, archive.zip) and no webhooks or notifications. Files are replaced under the same name, so changes must be detected by comparing SHA-256 checksums.
Data in data/ and .env are gitignored because the data is confidential. Never put data values in code or in external requests.
Team workflow files CLAUDE.md and PROGRESS.md require claiming work in PROGRESS.md. Pushing requires Entire brain to be connected.
Entire 0.13.4 stores checkpoints as per-checkpoint refs (refs/entire/checkpoints/<xx>/<id>), not in the old entire/checkpoints/v1 branch. Verify with git ls-remote origin 'refs/entire/checkpoints/*'.
'entire brain setup' modifies CLAUDE.md; restore the committed version before pushing.

The product now runs as one FastAPI server on port 8000: app, call webhooks (calls.py), and background loops (background.py: watcher, escalation, reply poller, enabled by ASK_BACKGROUND=on). Both tunnel hosts point to it.

State directory env var is now ASK_STATE_DIR (formerly ASK_SOONY_STATE_DIR). On akshat/integration, actions.json is a list and decision_status.json holds decisions. The old dict format would wipe action history.
iPhone home-screen PWAs do not show the Basic Auth dialog and do not persist it, which causes a white screen on 401. A cookie login page with a 30-day cookie fixes it.
GitHub 'ready to merge' only means no textual conflicts. PR #3 targeted akshat/dashboard, while the team had moved to akshat/integration, so semantic breakage went unseen.
Hold-to-talk was tried and rejected by the user; hands-free calls with English-forced transcription are preferred.

code.finding: Shared send/deliver path for voice and the inbox Approve button, using Akshat's new card format; the recipient must be a known supplier.
Reply poller matches supplier replies by thread (fallback Re: subject plus sender) and attaches a summary to the card. Ported to the actions.json list and decision_status.json.
Voice component rebuilt for Akshat's DecisionCard, which has a single-decision page at /d/<id> as the push target.
Enable-alerts button in the header, independent of whether any cards exist.

workflow: A fixed deterministic poll loop with versioned storage, plus an LLM extraction/reconcile layer and plain-code recomputation, is the architecture that fits 'new drops' and keeps numbers checkable.
Use subagents for bulk cross-checking (200 order confirmations and 59 scans) while the main session continues reading.
Check whether teammates pushed and read PROGRESS.md before building. Ask before pushing. Confirm the shell output filter didn't swallow a failed push by verifying the remote head afterwards.
When a review refers to unfamiliar names, first identify which branch it targets before answering.
Verify claims about other agents' tooling with git ls-remote instead of assuming.

friction: The inbox first showed Akshat's sample fixtures (supplier-one.example.com) because no real cards existed; the verifier had to be run from a temp worktree to produce them.
Chinese or Korean characters appeared in transcripts from background voices, and the transcript order was wrong. The hold-to-talk fix was rejected by the user.
The goodbye was cut off by a hang-up timer that fired 4 s after sending the mail.
The first push was lost because the output filter crashed; it had to be repeated.
Three merge conflicts with Akshat's changes in api.py/App.tsx and similar files; 'entire brain setup' modified CLAUDE.md.
Akshat merged by hand into akshat/integration on a rebuilt UI and card API, which left the voice, push and PWA front end missing and caused the actions.json format conflict.
One alert test failed only in the full suite run (order-dependent), then passed on reruns.
entire plugin install graph failed without --force because v0.4.0 was already installed.
Long-line lint errors in Akshat's test_platform.py were left alone.
open_items: Commit and push the port of the alert agent onto akshat/integration, then open a new PR into that branch.
Resolve the 'Ask me / Autonomous' and per-card allow/edit/dismiss controls with Akshat (confirmed not needed).
Voice assistant should use the new approve/escalate/dismiss endpoints instead of the legacy /api/cards/{id}/action bridge.
Build automatic escalation: a critical card triggers a push, then a Twilio/GPT-Realtime call if nobody answers. ASK_CALL_PROVIDER is currently dry_run.
Add a revise_draft tool so mail drafts can be changed during the conversation.
Test the real iPhone behavior: cookie login, push delivery, and real phone calls over the unified server.
Investigate the order-dependent flaky alert test.
Reply to Boise about EXW/DDP terms, and send the Karton Nowak art-book order within its 24h offer. Register the sender address in the portal.
Update the briefing page and doc to the 14:37 drop and later state; decide whether to delete the old Claude doc.
Demo script, 3-minute video and README paragraph on the alert agent.
Change the shared portal password after the hack, since it was posted in Discord.
Remove or update the old fixtures in web/fixtures and the dashboard contract doc (Akshat's decision).
